entities.summary: Syalakh culture is an early Neolithic culture of Yakutia and Eastern Siberia. It formed in the middle Lena River basin in the V — IV millenniums BCE as a result of the migration of tribes from Transbaikalia, which assimilated the local Sumnagin culture that was preceramic.
